# Jim Rose

[computational biology · spatial transcriptomics · single-cell genomics]{.role}

::: {.hero-bio}
Hi, I'm Jim. I'm a computational biologist at Emory University working at the intersection of genomics and immunology. I build methods and pipelines for spatial transcriptomics and single-cell data, and I care a lot about teaching biologists to code.
:::
